items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: I had to get after Mickey myself, see, because he's the one that sold it to -- did business with RCA.

ctx.x: Right after I feel good and I ain't thinking about writing nothing now.

Oh, in that album I got what I call "Satchmo's Dream." In that album you got. But it took them a long time to get that thing out. They keep fooling around. I had to get after Mickey myself, see, because he's the one that sold it to -- did business with RCA.
How long ago did he sell it?
